'''Yifeng Liu''' ({{Lang-zh|s=刘一峰|p=Liú Yīfēng}}; born July 19, 1985) is a Chinese professor of mathematics at [[Zhejiang University]] specializing in [[number theory]], [[automorphic form]]s and [[arithmetic geometry]].<ref name="百度安全验证">{{Cite web|url=https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1701341611717418423&wfr=spider&for=pc|title = 百度安全验证}}</ref>

==Career==
Liu graduated from [[Peking University]] with a [[Bachelor of Science]] in 2007 and earned his [[Ph.D.]] from [[Columbia University]] in 2012 under [[Shou-Wu Zhang]]. He was a C.L.E. Moore Instructor at [[MIT]] from 2012 to 2015 and an assistant professor at [[Northwestern University]] from 2015 to 2018 before being appointed an associate professor at Yale University.<ref name="DPMMS"/><ref name="hindu"/> Liu returned to China in 2021 to join [[Zheijiang University]] became a full professor of mathematics.<ref name="百度安全验证"/>

Liu has made important contributions to arithmetic geometry and number theory.  His contributions span a wide spectrum of topics such as arithmetic [[Theta correspondence|theta lift]]s and derivatives of [[L-functions]], the [[Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture]] and its arithmetic counterpart, the [[Special values of L-functions|Beilinson–Bloch–Kato conjecture]], the [[Geometric Langlands correspondence|geometric Langlands program]], the p-adic [[Waldspurger formula|Waldspurger theorem]], and the study of [[étale cohomology]] on [[Artin stack]]s.<ref name="DPMMS"/>

==Awards==
He received a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] in 2017.<ref name="DPMMS">{{cite web |title=Yifeng Liu and Jack Thorne to receive 2018 SASTRA Ramanujan Prize |url=https://www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk/news/sastraprize2018newsrelease.pdf |website=DPMMS News |publisher=Department of Pure Mathematics and Mathematical Statistics, Cambridge University |access-date=3 February 2019 |archive-date=11 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181011133407/https://www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk/news/sastraprize2018newsrelease.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He was awarded the 2018 [[SASTRA Ramanujan Prize]] for his contributions to the field of mathematics. He shared the prize with [[Jack Thorne (mathematician)|Jack Thorne]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Maeve Forti |title=Yifeng Liu wins prestigious award in mathematics |url=https://news.yale.edu/2018/10/25/yifeng-liu-wins-prestigious-award-mathematics |website=YaleNews |date=25 October 2018 |publisher=Yale University |access-date=3 February 2019}}</ref><ref name="hindu">{{cite journal |title=Yale, Cambridge profs. get SASTRA-Ramanujan Award |journal=The Hindu |date=December 22, 2018 |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/yale-cambridge-profs-get-sastra-ramanujan-award/article25803389.ece |access-date=3 February 2019}}</ref>
